title: How is Hitler connected to Messi?
description:
Six real photos connect Adolf Hitler to Lionel Messi, through his foreign minister, Stalin, Khrushchev, Fidel Castro and Argentina's president.

Adolf Hitler → Joachim von Ribbentrop → Joseph Stalin → Nikita Khrushchev → Fidel Castro → Cristina Fernández de Kirchner → Lionel Messi

How they're connected (every photo is real and sourced):
1. Hitler → Ribbentrop: In 1939, during the invasion of Poland, foreign minister Joachim von Ribbentrop joined Hitler at his headquarters train.
   Photo, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Podr%C3%B3%C5%BC_inspekcyjna_Adolfa_Hitlera_w_czasie_kampanii_wrze%C5%9Bniowej_(2-3).jpg
2. Ribbentrop → Stalin: In 1939, Ribbentrop flew to Moscow and shook hands with Joseph Stalin at the Nazi-Soviet pact signing.
   Photo, CC BY-SA 3.0 de: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Bundesarchiv_Bild_183-H27337,_Moskau,_Stalin_und_Ribbentrop_im_Kreml.jpg
3. Stalin → Khrushchev: In the 1930s, Stalin's Moscow party boss was a rising star named Nikita Khrushchev.
   Photo, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Joseph_Stalin_and_Nikita_Khrushchev_1930s.jpg
4. Khrushchev → Castro: In 1960, Khrushchev and Fidel Castro met in New York during the United Nations General Assembly.
   Photo by Herman Hiller, New York World-Telegram & Sun / Library of Congress, No known restrictions (NYWT&S staff photograph): https://www.loc.gov/item/00652628/
5. Castro → Kirchner: In 2009, Argentina's president, Cristina Kirchner, flew to Havana and met privately with Fidel Castro.
   Photo, CC BY 2.0: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Cristina_Fern%C3%A1ndez_de_Kircher_y_Fidel_Castro_-_2009.jpg
6. Kirchner → Messi: And in 2014, Cristina Kirchner welcomed home Argentina's World Cup captain, Lionel Messi.
   Photo by Casa Rosada Presidencia de la nación Argentina., CC BY 2.0: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Cristina_Fern%C3%A1ndez_y_la_Selecci%C3%B3n_Argentina_de_f%C3%BAtbol_2014_,2.jpg

Research notes: No free photo shows Ribbentrop with anyone who lived into Messi's era, so the chain leaves through his 1939 Kremlin handshake with Stalin; a Castro to Maradona to Messi ending would have needed two press photos, while Argentina's presidency photographed Cristina Kirchner with both Castro and Messi.

Give me two names in the comments and I'll find the photos that connect them.

#adolfhitler #lionelmessi #sixdegrees #history #didyouknow #shorts
first_comment:
Fun fact from the research: When Khrushchev first met Fidel Castro in 1960, he drove up to Harlem's Hotel Theresa, where Castro had moved after a row with his Midtown hotel.

Who should Hitler connect to next? Name anyone (a character works too) and I'll find the photos.
